inputs.text: President Luis Abinader is over in France pushing the Dominican Republic into these global transparency standards, but it's nothing more than another elite maneuver to look like reformers while dodging the real problems that matter. On 25 March 2026, Foreign Minister Roberto Álvarez and OECD Secretary-General Mathias Cormann signed a Memorandum of Understanding in Paris to launch the country's first National Integrity and Anti-Corruption Strategy, with President Abinader right there as a witness. These pacts always get sold as progress, but they just hand more power to progressive global outfits like the OECD that erode national sovereignty and the traditional Dominican values that have kept our society stable. Real solutions come from rebuilding strong national authority, personal responsibility, and cultural continuity right here at home, not from making deals with outsiders who care more about their own agendas than our people's order and self-reliance.
